summary: Iter282 tested split payment (WalletPay on Travel eSIM, fax buy and the Checkout texting add-on), the 402 'Add funds' link, saved-profile ZIP reuse (backend and frontend), a copy-truncation audit at 390 and 1440 on 14 app pages and the landing pages, and fax through MultiTEL (live search, dry-run buy, unit tests of pollInbox/pollOutbox/sendFax). Backend: the new pytest passes 11/11. ZIP reuse works: with no ZIP sent, the mobile and eSIM orders take the profile ZIP, an updated profile is used for new orders, earlier orders keep the old ZIP, a ZIP typed by the user wins, and a non-US profile still asks for a ZIP. Fax offer shows available:true, a US 212 search returns MultiTEL numbers, and the dry-run buy saves provider multitel_fax. The new multitel_fax_unit_test.js passes 9/16 and FAILS 7, which point to real bugs in js/multitel/fax.js. pollInbox reads f.from/f.to, but the MultiTEL fax_inbox rows use from_number/to_number, so every received fax gets to='+' and is dropped as unknown. pollOutbox matches on from+to+time instead of the uuid (= job_id) and only treats 'success' as delivered. Frontend: every requested prefill works (mobile-offer-zip 10001 then 94105 after the profile update, checkout-texting-zip, landing mobile-co-zip and esim-co-zip). Travel eSIM and fax checkouts show the short note and 'Pay the $10.00 rest with crypto' when the wallet is short, and the wallet button plus 'Pay with crypto' when the wallet covers it. The lookup 402 shows lookup-single-error-topup, which goes to /cloudivr/app/wallet. The card option never shows, because Mollie is off in preview (options enabled:false, comingSoon). The Home stats and sidebar wrap correctly. Remaining truncation: the carrier column in Lookup 'Recent checks' at 390 (cut to 'M'), the Settings email-log subjects at 390, and SIP landing 'sip.cloudivr.net' at 390 (2px). Fax search region text shows raw data such as 'New York, {state: NY, rate_center: ADAMS, lata: 136}'.

critical.issue: MultiTEL fax_inbox rows have from_number/to_number (per the v3 docs), but the code reads f.from/f.to, so payload.to='+' and payload.from='+'. onReceived -> findOwner('+') logs 'received for unknown number +' and the fax is dropped. Received faxes on MultiTEL numbers are never delivered, and each PDF is downloaded again on every poll for 2 days (fax_file also marks it viewed). Failed inbox rows (status!='success') are not skipped either.

fax_outbox rows include uuid (= the send_fax job_id), but the code matches on from+to+sent_at, and the comment 'the outbox has no job id' is wrong. sent_at is a server-local string with no timezone (parsed as local in Node) and can be null, so matching by time is fragile: two faxes to the same recipient can take each other's result. Only /success|failed/ is handled, so a 'sent' or 'completed' status (the docs say processing can report a sent or completed state) leaves faxes stuck in 'queued' forever. It reads hit.pages/status_text, but the outbox fields are pages_sent/result_text, so failure_reason is always 'fax_communication_error'. Fix: match r.uuid === p._id.replace('mtfax:',''), or poll GET /v3/fax_status?job_id=.

minor.issue: The region shows raw MultiTEL data: 'New York, {state: NY, rate_center: ADAMS, lata: 136}' and 'Ohio, {state: OH, rate_center: Aberdeen, lata: }'. js/multitel/index.js searchNumbers builds region_name from n.info?.state, which is a stringified object. This now appears in the fax-buy result cards and also feeds the voice search. Also, a 212 search returns area 680/347 numbers (they are flagged nearby).

profileZip() is declared twice (identical copies). buy() has the line 'if (!zipcode) zipcode = await profileZip(chatId)' twice, and buyMobile() calls '|| await profileZip(chatId) || await profileZip(chatId)'. The duplicate DB reads are harmless but look like a bad edit; remove the copies.

fax-numbers.js acct.enabled() is now MultiTEL-only. Last round's notes say production MultiTEL refuses the server IP 146.190.238.190 (isBlocked), so fax numbers will show available:false on the live site until the IP is allow-listed. There is no fallback to SignalWire.

Now 14/19 (5 alert assertions FAIL). provider-health once() keeps its throttle in SEEN_FILE on disk, shared with the running server and earlier runs, so the 12h throttle suppresses the alerts the test expects. This is test isolation, not a code change in this round. The test also writes the live throttle file, which can mute real preview alerts for 12h.

ui_bugs.issue: The carrier span 'flex-1 truncate' ends up 4px wide, so 'Multiple OCN Listing' shows as 'M'. The w-48 number and w-28 type spans take the whole row. Let it wrap (basis-full / min-w-0 break-words).
Subjects are cut with an ellipsis, e.g. 'Next step for +19053874823: sign the authorization letter' at 185px.

integration_issues.issue: travel-esim-pay-card-open and fax-buy-paybox-card-open never render. /wallet/mollie/options returns enabled:false, comingSoon:true in preview, so only crypto is offered. This is expected while Mollie is off and is not a code bug.

issues: It uses a plain <a href> built from window.location.pathname.split('/app')[0], which causes a full page reload. On a page with no '/app' in the path (e.g. /cloudivr/sip) it would produce /cloudivr/sip/app/wallet. Use <Link to={cp('/app/wallet')}>.

design_issues.screen: CryptoPay when the wallet already covers the price
issues: With $50 in the wallet, a $6.90 eSIM shows 'Send $10 in crypto… pays for this right away'. That is correct (min top-up), but it could make users think crypto is required.

action_items: Fix js/multitel/fax.js pollInbox: use f.from_number/f.to_number and skip rows whose status is not 'success'
Fix pollOutbox: match on r.uuid (job_id) or poll /v3/fax_status?job_id=; treat sent/completed/success as delivered; use pages_sent and result_text
Clean up the fax search region text (multitel/index.js searchNumbers: parse n.info.state, or use only a.name / state)
Remove the duplicate profileZip() declaration and the duplicate calls in js/spenza.js
Fix the Lookup Recent checks row on mobile so the carrier text isn't cut to 1 letter; let the Settings email-log subjects wrap
Optional: ErrorNote topup should use a Link with cp('/app/wallet'); isolate provider_health_unit_test from the live SEEN_FILE
critical_code_review_comments: multitel/fax.js: field names in pollInbox and pollOutbox don't match the MultiTEL v3 docs (fax_inbox: hash/from_number/to_number/status; fax_outbox: uuid/from_number/to_number/pages_sent/result_text/sent_at nullable). The live inbox and outbox are empty, so this could not be checked against real rows; the unit test uses the documented shapes.
fax-service maintain(): the inbox poll uses limit=100 and date_from = 2 days ago with no paging. That is fine at low volume.
useSavedAddress: the module-level 'inflight' promise is cached for 2 s. A screen opened within 2 s of saving the profile can show the old ZIP. Minor.
LoaStep prefill triggers the draft autosave right away (PUT /hosted-sms/:id/draft with the profile values). That is acceptable, but the draft then exists without the user typing anything.

success_rate.backend: pytest 11/11 (100%); multitel fax unit 9/16 (bugs found); fax_service regression 52/52; bird_only 22/22
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows OK; 3 truncation leftovers; card option hidden because Mollie is off)

rca of the issue: Received MultiTEL faxes are dropped because multitel/fax.js pollInbox maps f.from/f.to, but the API returns from_number/to_number. Repro: node backend/tests/multitel_fax_unit_test.js shows payload.to = '+'. In fax-service.onReceived, findOwner('+') returns null, so the code logs 'received for unknown number +' and returns. The fax is never inserted, so the next poll downloads it again. Fix: e164(f.from_number) / e164(f.to_number), and skip rows with f.status !== 'success'.
